Specification: This module is a model-checking wrapper around a two-phase commit specification. It defines a typing invariant for the resource-manager and transaction-manager state, imports a separate transaction-commit specification via INSTANCE, and states a theorem that the two-phase commit specification implies the imported transaction-commit property. The file itself contains no actions, no temporal specification definition of its own, and no fault model beyond what may exist in extended or instantiated modules, which are not extracted here.
